answers.core: I think having it as an add-on will be quite hacky, and still, this wouldn't solve problem [1]
answers.workaround:
you can solve [2] (overlapping events), but not [1] (a need to manually add actions and bindings for many nodes added from AssetLib or other places).
Actually [1] cannot be solved completely, some asset/template creators will ignore the feature anyway.
But I still think this feature would be used often.
